description: This file is a shell script used for configuring and setting options in the TensorFlow project's build process, particularly related to remote caching and environment setup on Windows systems.

methods.name: run_configure_for_cpu_build
methods.description: Runs the TensorFlow configure script with default responses to set up for CPU build.

methods.name: set_remote_cache_options
methods.description: Appends remote cache configuration options to a temporary Bazel rc file.

methods.name: create_python_test_dir
methods.description: Deletes and recreates a directory, then creates a junction link to the tensorflow source directory.
